scientific.integrity: The proof diagonalizes the exact outer-cycle polynomial. The parity stability frontier follows from the scalar modal inequalities, and the minimax statement is proved by an endpoint optimization with a separate monotonicity argument for odd synchronization periods.
limitations: Deterministic symmetric positive-definite quadratics with plain gradient descent as the inner optimizer only.
The slow interpolation coefficient and inner learning rate are fixed globally; adaptive slow steps are outside the theorem.
The minimax criterion is asymptotic slow-weight spectral contraction over a known curvature interval.
No claim is made about stochastic variance reduction, generalization, nonquadratic objectives, or adaptive inner optimizers.

title: Parity stability without minimax acceleration in Lookahead-SGD quadratics
